# Buddy

> Buddy is a DevOps & Platform Engineering automation platform providing CI/CD pipelines, environments, integrations, deployments, domain management, and sandboxes.

## Core
- [DevOps & Platform Engineering Suite](https://buddy.works) - DevOps & Platform Engineering Copilot
- [Sign up](https://buddy.works/sign-up) - Sign up with email or Git provider and try all features for free
- [Buddy Pricing and Plans](https://buddy.works/pricing) - Cloud pricing plans: Free, Pro, and Hyper tiers


## Docs
- [Buddy Documentation](https://buddy.works/docs) - Complete documentation for Buddy DevOps platform
- [Buddy OpenAPI Specification](https://buddy.works/openapi.json) - Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec for the Buddy REST API
